method.description: Scope correction only. The document's geographic reach was established from the adopted California legal design and the queue's own recorded identity, and the recorded automated-retrieval status was re-tested by HEAD request without transferring any body. No binary was downloaded and no legal mechanism was altered.
method.binariesDownloadedNote: This job is pinned to zero downloads and its purpose is scope, not acquisition. The binary was deliberately not retrieved even though a HEAD probe shows it is currently reachable. Acquiring it and reading its printed revision is a separate operations step.

scopeCorrection.officialTitle: Petition for Sealing of Arrest Records After Successful Completion of Pen. Code § 851.90 Diversion or Deferred Entry of Judgment
evidence: The adopted California legal design states of this route: 'There is no statewide Judicial Council form; counties publish their own.'
The track's geography is recorded as scope=county with keys san-diego and kern, and the venue note reads 'Local practice and local forms govern; there is no statewide form.'
The queue's own recorded title for the document is 'Superior Court of California, County of San Diego, local form SDSC CRM-307' — the issuer is a single superior court, not the Judicial Council.
The document is served from sdcourt.ca.gov, the San Diego court's own host, not from courts.ca.gov.

exactLocalCourt.court: Superior Court of California, County of San Diego
exactLocalCourt.authorityToPublish: A California superior court's own local form, adopted under local rules because no Judicial Council form exists for Penal Code § 851.90 sealing.
exactLocalCourt.bindingNote: SDSC CRM-307 has no force in any other California county. Kern County's own local petition is recorded as the second confirmed example of a county publishing its own set.

stage.label: County petition and order set
stage.unavailableReason: No approved local petition and order set has been sourced for any county. County-specific form and filing coverage is a retained blocker, and it is a scope restriction on which counties are supported rather than a reason to suppress the guidance unit.

exactRouteRelationship.meaning: CRM-307 is not the track's filing. It is one county's instance of stage 2 of a two-stage sequential composed track, and stage 2 is currently unavailable for every county.

statewideFallback.label: Explain the route and identify the local form
statewideFallback.behaviour: Statewide guidance explains the disposition and the automatic portions, then directs the participant to ask their county clerk or self-help centre which local form applies. LegalEase does not select the local form.
statewideFallback.whyNoStatewideForm: Penal Code § 851.90 sealing has no Judicial Council form. The statewide position is guidance, not a filing, and that is the correct fallback rather than a gap to be filled by promoting a county form.
statewideFallback.criticalRule: Stage 1 must not be suppressed because stage 2 is unavailable. The unavailability of county forms is a scope restriction on which counties are supported, not a reason to withhold the statewide guidance.

runtimeEffect.statewidePromotionRationale: Promoting a San Diego local form statewide would generate a filing that 57 other counties have no obligation to accept and that misstates which court's form the participant is filing. The correct statewide behaviour is stage-1 guidance.
runtimeEffect.countyScopedPromotionPossible: Only if counsel decides ca-diversion-seal stage 2 becomes a county-scoped track, and only for counties whose local set has been sourced and approved. No county qualifies today.

counselDecisionRequired.question: Does ca-diversion-seal stage 2 become a county-scoped track, or does it stay failed closed?
counselDecisionRequired.constraint: Do not manifest SDSC CRM-307 before that decision. Manifesting it first would create a retained asset for a route whose scope is undecided.
